court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Additional Mahila Court, Metropolitan Magistrate at Allikulam, Chennai - D.V.C.No.50 of 2018
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The petitioner's wife left her job and stayed with his parents after he asked her to do so. He then left for Italy, leaving his parents in charge of his wife. His mother took over the custody of his belongings. The wife underwent humiliation and harassment while abroad.

legal_principles.principle: The invocation of provision of DV Act by the respondent is malafide and is liable to be thrown out inlimine.
legal_principles.held: The events narrated above would show that the invocation of provision of DV Act by the 1st respondent is malafide and is liable to be thrown out inlimine.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: The court below ought not to have entertained the petition filed 7 years after the parties started living separately.
legal_principles.held: The court below ought not to have entertained the petition, filed 7 years after the parties started living separately.

legal_principles.principle: The initiation of impugned proceedings cannot be sustained and is liable to be rejected.
legal_principles.held: The entire proceedings of the instant case is an abuse of process of law and continuation of the said proceedings will amount to miscarriage of justice and looked at from any angle the initiation of the impugned proceedings cannot be sustained and is liable to be rejected.

outcome.final_order: The entire proceedings initiated under Sections 12, 18, 20 & 22 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 were struck off.
